Subject: MAP & Kickoff: Brightwell Health onboarding

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move forward. We need to lock down a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a high-level milestone timeline so we can present to execs next Tuesday. Rough priorities from our side: data mapping, security questionnaire, and a short pilot (30 days) with 3 endpoints.

Can you send a simple heatmap of milestones/owners and a proposed kickoff date window? Also include any SOW draft or timeline assumptions we should review. I've attached the procurement intake doc we use (SOW_request.pdf).

Best,

Hi Claire — great to hear. Attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Brightwell_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW outline (SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf). High-level:

• Proposed kickoff window: Sep 21–24 (kickoff workshop + engineering alignment)
• Pilot target: Oct 5 start, 30-day pilot, acceptance criteria: 3 endpoints, latency under 300ms p95, and baseline quality checks
• Key milestones (week-based):
  - Week 0: Kickoff & access provisioning (owner: Alex)
  - Week 1–2: Data mapping & consent checks (owner: Laura)
  - Week 3: Security evidence handoff (owner: Karthik)
  - Week 4: Pilot run & monitoring setup (owner: Alex)
  - Week 8: Pilot review & go/no-go (owner: Brightwell / Alex)

I've included a quick heatmap tab in the spreadsheet showing critical path items and slack. Can you confirm the kickoff window and if the pilot acceptance criteria work for you?

Thanks — looping Karthik and Laura to confirm owners and any risk notes.

--
Alex Martinez

alex_martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Claire's ask and the MAP I just sent. Short asks:

1) Karthik: can you validate the security evidence timeline and confirm SOC2 artifact delivery (we may need an expedited packet for their procurement team). If we can't get all docs by Week 3, propose a fallback (redaction or attestation) we can accept for pilot.

2) Laura: data mapping owners — who on your team will own the schema review and test data provisioning? Claire mentioned a small ETL team and a sandbox export. Estimate 3–5 business days to validate.

Risks I see:
• Procurement needs an SOW with pricing line items — finance may need to be looped early.
• Access to staging environment could be delayed if Brightwell's security policy requires extra approvals.

If both of you can reply with owners + any timing adjustments by EOD, I'll push an updated MAP back to Claire and propose the Sep 22 kickoff slot (mid-week looks best given exec availability).

Thanks,
Alex
